fact: National Treasury told the Standing Committee on Finance it maintains four legacy systems for national and provincial departments: PERSAL (pays 1.5 million salaries monthly), BAS (1.5 million daily transactions, 39,000 users), LOGIS and Vulindlela, with the IFMS intended to replace them.
title: ATC230503: Report of the Standing Committee on Finance on the Oversight Visit to the National Treasury, dated 02 May 2023
publisher: Standing Committee on Finance, Parliament of South Africa (via PMG)
